blocks.content: Abelardo de la Espriella was sworn in on 7 August 2026 as the 36th President of Colombia for the 2026–2030 term. He succeeded Gustavo Petro, whose presidency was Colombia ’s first left-wing administration at the national level.

items: Colombia is a presidential republic in northern South America.
The President of Colombia serves a four-year term under the 1991 Constitution.
Gustavo Petro became Colombia’s first left-wing president in 2022.
Runoff elections are used in Colombia when no candidate secures a majority in the first round.
